title: Android GLES3: glMapBufferRange null causes memcpy crash in RasterizerCanvasGLES3::_render_items
body:
### Tested versions

- Observed in: 4.6.3.stable Android release template (production report; not locally reproducible).
- Not tested: other Godot versions.

### System information

Android 10; Xiaomi Redmi Note 8; arm64-v8a; Snapdragon 665 / Adreno 610; driver version unavailable. Godot renderer: gl_compatibility (GLES3).

### Issue description

Crashlytics recorded 3 identical SIGSEGV events from one Redmi Note 8 user. I symbolicated the native stack locally using the matching official Godot 4.6.3 Android arm64 debug library (BuildId e3254c34ee1b6c5b6d2bf697520e8089b4ebe5bc).

The fault is a null-pointer memcpy in RasterizerCanvasGLES3::_render_items. The faulting PC is 0x1fdb898; AArch64 disassembly shows it is the memcpy immediately after glMapBufferRange(GL_UNIFORM_BUFFER, ..., GL_MAP_WRITE_BIT | GL_MAP_UNSYNCHRONIZED_BIT). The crash signal reports fault address 0x0, so the mapped pointer returned by the driver was null and is copied into without a guard.

Relevant source path:

~~~cpp
void *ubo = glMapBufferRange(GL_UNIFORM_BUFFER, 0, sizeof(LightUniform) * light_count, GL_MAP_WRITE_BIT | GL_MAP_UNSYNCHRONIZED_BIT);
memcpy(ubo, state.light_uniforms, sizeof(LightUniform) * light_count);
glUnmapBuffer(GL_UNIFORM_BUFFER);
~~~

This application has no custom GL/EGL context or GL calls outside Godot. It uses the Compatibility renderer intentionally; this is not an ABI split/load failure or a GDScript exception.

Related, but not a duplicate: #85201 concerns the same unchecked glMapBufferRange + memcpy pattern for an instance buffer. #122114 has a similar signature but is specifically about a second context on Windows; that condition does not apply here.

Expected behavior: a null mapping should not crash the process. A guard with glBufferSubData fallback (and ideally a diagnostic) would make this driver failure recoverable.

Symbolicated stack:

~~~text
libc.so!memcpy
RasterizerCanvasGLES3::_render_items + 1244  (rasterizer_canvas_gles3.cpp:675, optimized line table)
RasterizerCanvasGLES3::canvas_render_items + 3808
RendererCanvasCull::_render_canvas_item_tree + 628
RendererCanvasCull::render_canvas + 340
RendererViewport::_draw_viewport + 6640
RendererViewport::draw_viewports + 1716
RenderingServerDefault::_draw + 396
Main::iteration + 1252
OS_Android::main_loop_iterate + 68
Java_org_godotengine_godot_GodotLib_step + 480
~~~

### Steps to reproduce

No deterministic reproduction yet; this is a production-only report from one device.

1. Run Godot 4.6.3.stable on Android with the gl_compatibility renderer.
2. On the affected Redmi Note 8 / Android 10 driver, a uniform-buffer glMapBufferRange returns null during 2D canvas rendering.
3. Godot calls memcpy on that null pointer and the process SIGSEGVs.

The robust engine-side reproduction condition is a GL implementation that returns null from that call; the source currently has no fallback.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A — production-only driver failure; no minimal deterministic reproduction or affected physical device is available. The exact build ID, raw PCs, local symbolication, and disassembly are included above.
